::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Hyderabad startup designing gallium-nitride power amplifiers and RF front-end ICs (amplifiers, active-antenna components, switches) for radar, satellite communication and wireless networks. Production status not disclosed.
:::

## What does this firm design?

GaN power amplifiers, RF switches and front-end ICs for radar, satcom and 5G.
